title: DCLab Code redesigned in the owner's Meadow kit (HeroUI's dashboard look): one rounded frame, white cards, pill controls
request: Owner, with screenshots of heroui.com's dashboard and of their own Meadow design kit: after all fixes, redesign the app with this style.
spec: dclab-code web/style.css (the look's tokens at the top)
plan: read the stylesheet (one file, every color a token)
new tokens: zinc greys, white cards, a green brand with dark ink, a green text accent for contrast, shadows, three radii, light and dark
the shapes: the conversation, drawer and split as floating cards; sidebar pills; pill buttons and segmented tabs; filled inputs; KPI-style stat tiles; green ticks and bars in the Jobs tab
look at it in the browser at 1440 px light and dark, and at 375 px

decisions.decision: only the stylesheet changes; no markup, no script
decisions.why: the same capabilities with a new look; every test of behaviour stands as it was

decisions.decision: two greens: the brand fill (#17c964) with dark ink on it, and a darker green (#0f9a4c) for green text on white
decisions.why: white text on the bright green and the bright green as text on white both fail contrast

decisions.decision: the system font until Outfit and Plus Jakarta Sans are served by the app
decisions.why: the app's content policy allows only its own fonts; adding the files is a download the owner approves

decisions.decision: a narrow composer wraps its controls to a second row; on a phone the git button hides
decisions.why: a project name squeezed onto two lines, and a title cut to one letter, at the widths the drawer leaves

decisions.decision: Meadow's own values, read from the owner's meadow.css, replace the first pass taken from a screenshot
decisions.why: the kit is on the owner's Mac; exact colors, radii and shadows beat colors picked by eye

findings.defect: the ask card was wider than DCLab's card and the composer
findings.scenario: an Allow card above a DCLab draft: two edges a few pixels apart
findings.cause: the thread's padding sat inside the card's border
findings.fix: ask and command cards take the composer's width

findings.defect: 'live-project' broke onto two lines in the composer with the drawer open
findings.scenario: 1440 px window, Jobs tab open: the main column about 540 px
findings.cause: the select shrank in the flex row
findings.fix: the row wraps; chips never shrink

findings.defect: the session's title shrank to one letter on a phone
findings.scenario: 375 px: the git button, Settings and the palette key took the top bar
findings.cause: no room rule for the top bar
findings.fix: the git button hides under 760 px
findings.test: the crumb measured 180 px at 375 px

measurements.name: tests
measurements.result: dclab-code 144 of 144 (units 52, page 30 in Chromium, server 62)

measurements.name: no sideways scroll on a phone
measurements.gate: scrollWidth equals the viewport at 375 px

outcome: DCLab Code looks like the owner's reference, light and dark, at desktop and phone widths, with every capability unchanged.
lessons: A redesign that keeps every color a token changes one file; a green brand needs a second, darker green for text.
risks: no web font: a machine without Inter or the Apple system font shows its own sans-serif
